keys.beat: The ship reaches the misty land of the Cimmerians at Ocean's edge.
keys.text: She came to the deep waters of the river Oceanus, where lie the land and city of the Cimmerians who live enshrouded in mist and darkness which the rays of the sun never pierce.

keys.beat: Odysseus digs a trench, pours libations, sacrifices sheep, and holds the spirits back with his sword.
keys.text: I dug the trench a cubit each way, and made a drink-offering to all the dead... when I had prayed sufficiently to the dead, I cut the throats of the two sheep and let the blood run into the trench.

keys.beat: The dead gather in multitudes, crying around the blood.
keys.text: The ghosts came trooping up from Erebus: brides, young bachelors, old men worn out with toil, maids who had been crossed in love, and brave men who had been killed in battle... they came from every quarter and flitted round the trench with a strange kind of screaming sound that made me turn pale with fear.

keys.beat: Odysseus waits for Tiresias before allowing any other shade to drink.
keys.text: I drew my sword and sat there, and would not let the poor feckless ghosts come near the blood till Teiresias should have answered my questions... then came the ghost of the Theban prophet Teiresias with his golden sceptre in his hand.
